evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0001?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The source of failure on checkout-service was isolated to misconfigured maximum connections parameter, which was set to 10 instead of 100. Engineering team isolated the source of failure on checkout-service and deployed a configuration update to set the maximum connections parameter to 100. [EVD-001]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0002?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The root cause was a Redis cache eviction triggered by the feature flag rollout, resulting in unexpected authentication token validation. Engineering team isolated the source of failure on feature-flags. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0003?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The root cause was a payment gateway endpoint URL update during PCI compliance credential rotation, which resulted in a critical disruption of operations on config-service. Engineering team isolated the source of failure on config-service and updated the endpoint. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0004?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The root cause was a CDN cache invalidation storm triggered by a bulk product catalog update, resulting in massive origin server load and search query latency. Engineering team isolated the source of failure on cdn-proxy, and the investigation progressed to isolate the origin server load. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0005?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The root cause was a message queue partition rebalancing during notification-service scaling, which caused consumer group desynchronization and message loss across email and push notification channels. Engineering team isolated the source of failure and is mitigating the issue. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0006?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The root cause was a schema migration on the data-warehouse that added a NOT NULL column without default value, causing locking writes to affected tables for 47 minutes during backfill of 12M rows. The incident was resolved by the DBA manually rolling back the migration and redesigning the migration [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0007?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The rate limiter configuration was incorrectly set to per-global scope, causing throttled API consumers. The resolution involved correcting the configuration to per-customer scope. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0008?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The root cause was an idempotency key collision in event deduplication logic, which inflated billing amounts for affected customers. The resolution involved recalculating billing amounts, updating the idempotency key generation, and adding a daily reconciliation job. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]
